title: /api skill v3 — AI fill TODO bodies in Phase 1.h+1.i scaffolds (revised)

status_history.note: write-spec initial output (479 lines). 4b 通用規則 全 PASS（無 line 錨點、Goals/Non-goals 互斥、Agent/Human 分段、無 ≥N counts）。5b 內部一致性 全 PASS（依賴關係 phase-1e == done）。5c Codex 外部審查回 5 個高 + 2 中 + 1 低 — 揭露根本問題：OC `ApplicationService` 協議 + `Iso8601ParsingError` + `ContextError<E>` 等住在 OC 的 `OCShared/`（context-local infra），不是 DDDKit。Genesis Phase 1.e 沒 bootstrap 這層 infra。沒它，/api 生成的 AS code 無法 compile。**User 決定**：先暫停 /api spec，開 **Phase 1.f** 讓 Genesis 補 ContextShared infra（`{Ctx}Shared/ApplicationService.swift` 等），再回來修 /api spec 的 5 個高風險 + 2 中 + 1 低 issue 後 ready。當前 status=draft，blocked on `phase-1f-context-shared-infra`。

**Spec v2 revised — 6 audit findings 全套修**。Phase 1.f bootstrap 解了 H3 (ApplicationService 協議) + H5 (Iso8601ParsingError) — 兩者現在於 `{Ctx}Shared/`。其餘 4 個 fix 套用在 v2 spec (554 lines)：(H1) ApplicationService template 拆兩個 — Base (always) + PayloadExtension (conditional on openapi requestBody)；(H2) `{AGG_ID_NAME}` 改 derive from `event.yaml aggregateRootId.alias` SSOT，AS Input shape = Service Input ∪ {operatorId} 而非 equality；(H4) ApiHandler skeleton + ApiComponents+ApiError 必須同步創建 (first-invocation single transaction)；switch exhaustive over 所有 `<A>Error.swift` cases (parse enum) 不只本 UC 拋的；(M1) Step 2 prerequisite check 加 parse `Package.swift` target plugins — 缺 OpenAPIGenerator → exit 1 with remediation；(M2) Step 5 加 grep `package func {ucCamel}(_` duplicate detection → exit 4；(L1) A13 whitelist-aware static lint — SKILL.md 不可寫非 Adapter/ Swift / 不可提到 read invariants.md 或 write openapi.yaml，且必須含「不讀 / 不寫 / 只寫 Adapter/」明文 sentence。**depends_on 更新**：加 `phase-1f-context-shared-infra`（解 H3+H5 的必要 dependency）。**新 exit code 4** for duplicate handler。**6 templates** (從 5 拆) 反映 H1 split。Status: draft → ready。下一步 /pickup（用戶實作 ~/.claude/skills/api/ + Genesis bundled mirror + golden examples + docs）。

**Spec v3 revised — fundamentally scope-shifted after Phase 1.h+1.i ship**。原 v2 all-AI generation 模式 obsolete：Phase 1.h emit AS + DTO scaffolds、Phase 1.i emit openapi.yaml + ApiHandler + ApiComponents + PackageRenderer plugin。**新 scope**: AI fill 4 TODO categories per write UC：(1) AS `execute()` body 從 Service Input 推 Service execute 呼叫；(2) ApiHandler method 內 `let asInput = { fatalError() }()` 改 payload→AS Input 構造 (Variant A 1:1 / Variant B 加 inline Decimal/Date 解析)；(3) DTO struct `init(from dto:) throws` 反向 mapper body；(4) ApiComponents switch 中 unreachable cases 改 `return nil // TODO`。**完全不做**: openapi.yaml / Package.swift / Service.swift / *.yaml 寫；scaffold emit；framework 動。**新 6-step flow**: arg parse → workspace locate → prerequisite check → parse 5 inputs (AS scaffold + Service Input + payload schema + Error enum + handler method block) → Variant A/B detection → fill 4 categories。**12 acceptance gates** (A1-A12) + Human E2E sign-off。**Server-generated ID detection rule**: Service Input 有 `*Id` String 但 AS Input 無 → UUID().uuidString case。**Audit findings**: 6H+2M+1L 從 v2 — 全 resolved or rendered moot by Phase 1.h+1.i ship；新 11 known limits 列 v3 scope。**Depends on**: phase-1f + phase-1h + phase-1i (全 DONE)。Status: still 'ready' (now revised v3)；下一步 user 自行 author SKILL.md content + manual E2E sign-off → mark done。Spec 554 → 380 lines.
